tools.name: nx_workspace
tools.description: Returns a readable representation of the nx project graph and the nx.json that configures nx. Use it to answer questions about the nx workspace and architecture

tools.name: nx_docs
tools.description: Returns a list of documentation sections that could be relevant to the user query. Use it to learn about nx, its configuration and options instead of assuming knowledge about it.

tools.description: Returns a list of generators that could be relevant to the user query.

tools.description: Returns the detailed JSON schema for an nx generator
